source.title: Indirect comparison of SGLT2 inhibitors in patients with established heart failure: evidence based on Bayesian methods

extraction_limitations: This is a secondary systematic review/network meta-analysis. Network and pooled result atoms describe the review analysis and do not imply that Chen et al. enrolled the underlying trial participants.
No head-to-head active-agent SGLT2 inhibitor trial was available. Active-agent estimates are indirect.
The exact project files README(2).md and example_atom.json were not available in the supplied project-source set; governing Python models and JSON schema were available and used.

The article repeatedly reports n=21,927 in endpoint sections, while the randomized arm denominators in Supplementary Table S3 sum to 21,947. Both values are preserved with different assertion origins.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated systematic-review/network-meta-analysis atom kind. Secondary-analysis results use existing result kinds with descriptive tags.
